payload.text:
Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that the claim R-0000357, taken on 2014-12-14, for $10.60, is under review. We require the amended promotion agreement (end date) before making a decision. The claim runs past the recorded promotion end, and the shelf price stayed promotional after it; the end date on file may be incorrect. The dispute deadline is 2015-06-12, and this deadline has passed.

Please provide the necessary document as soon as possible.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.

Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that we have received your claim R-0000357, dated 2014-12-14, for $10.60. According to our records, the promotion ended on a different date than what is stated in the claim. The shelf price remained promotional after the recorded end date, suggesting the end date on file might be incorrect. We require the amended promotion agreement (end date) to make a decision on this claim.

Given that the dispute deadline of 2015-06-12 has passed, we will not be requesting any action by that date. Please provide the necessary document as soon as possible.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
